about: Round 733: every row of public.golf_majors checked against the championship's own champions list plus a second, independent list. The table was read with SELECT through the Supabase MCP on the check date (526 rows; the read hash below is md5 of id|year|tournament|player_name ordered by id, joined by newlines). The fix is supabase/migrations/20260930_round_733_golf_majors.sql, UNAPPLIED, and scripts/simGolfMajors.mjs holds that migration's end state to this record.

read.confirmedThrough: GET /rest/v1/golf_majors?select=id,year,tournament,player_name,nationality,score,venue,tour,rank&order=id.asc with the public anon key from src/integrations/supabase/client.ts, the read simAdminAccess makes, on 2026-09-30 during the round 733 fix: 526 rows, every stored value equal to this record, and the read hash reproduced

end.hashOf: md5 of year|tournament|player_name ordered by tournament (C collation) then year, joined by newlines

shownBy: src/lib/listQuiz.ts reads golf_majors four times (masters-champs, pga-champs, theopen-champs, usopen-golf-champs), each the player_name column only. year and tournament identify the row. No other file under src, supabase or the database functions reads the table.

notVerified.why: No game reads them, so this round did not verify them row by row. They are not what their names say for most rows: the Masters stores the total in score and the score to par in venue; the PGA Championship stores the final margin and the runner up (1916 to 1957) or the course and the town (1958 on); the U.S. Open, The Open and the Women's British Open store the course in score and the town in venue. Do not wire a game to them without a round that verifies them. The three filled rows follow that column use and cite their sources for it.

sources.masters: masters.com Past Winners (each year's page is served from /en_US/json/gen/history/<year>.json; the 2026 final leaderboard is the 2026 scores feed; the war years are the masters.com article When War Interrupted) and ESPN's all time Masters winners list (updated 2026-04-12)
sources.pga: pgachampionship.com PGA Championship winners and venues (through 2025; its 2025 line misprints Scottie as Scott) and its report Aaron Rai wins the 2026 PGA Championship at Aronimink; ESPN's all time PGA Championship winners list (updated 2026-05-18)
sources.open: theopen.com Our 92 Champion Golfers (1860 to 2026) and ESPN's all time Open Championship winners list (updated 2026-07-19)
sources.usOpen: usga.org U.S. Open Results: 1895 to Present (through 2025) and the usopen.com 2026 champion page; ESPN's U.S. Open winners by year (updated 2026-06-21)
sources.women: aigwomensopen.com Previous Championships (the R&A, through 2025) and lpga.com AIG Women's Open Past Winners (the LPGA Tour, a separate organisation, through 2026). No ESPN, BBC, AP or Reuters list of every winner was found, so the second source for 2001 to 2025 is the LPGA Tour's own list; the 2026 row adds ESPN. No game reads these rows.
sources.note: ESPN pages refuse plain HTTP clients; they were read in a browser and through ESPN's content API for the same story ids, which serves the same text.
